mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contest_rank_entry (contest_id, version, user_id, rank_no, row_position, score, correct_count, answered_count, handed_in, created_at) SELECT #{contestId}, #{version}, ranked.user_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ranked.total_score DESC), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ranked.total_score DESC, ranked.user_id ASC), ranked.total_score, ranked.correct_count, ranked.answered_count, ranked.handed_in, #{createdAt} FROM ( SELECT uc.user_id, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.scoring_version = 1 OR COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(cr.score, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS total_score, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (c.scoring_version = 1 OR COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) > 0) AND cr.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS correct_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.scoring_version = 1 AND cr.record_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 WHEN c.scoring_version <> 1 AND COALESCE(cr.applied_attempt_seq, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS UNSIGNED) AS answered_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_submit us WHERE us.contest_id = uc.contest_id AND us.user_id = uc.user_id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS handed_in FROM user_contest uc INNER JOIN contest c ON c.contest_id = uc.contest_id LEFT JOIN contest_records cr ON cr.contest_id = uc.contest_id AND cr.user_id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.contest_id = #{contestId} AND c.type = 0 AND c.del_flag = 0 GROUP BY uc.user_id, c.scoring_version, uc.contest_id ) ranked
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contest_rank_entry WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND version = #{version}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_contest WHERE contest_id = #{contestId}
